To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Fire Weather Index System can be used as a guideline in designing efficient fire monitoring systems, and that the coverage problem can be used as an abstraction of forest fire monitoring.
the FWI System is a useful tool for forest fire modeling and early detection.

(1) the FWI System is a comprehensive model for the dynamics of forest fires, which can be easily adapted to design efficient fire detection systems; (2) the coverage problem is a natural way to model the forest fire early detection problem; and (3) the data aggregation scheme based of the FWI system can significantly prolong the network lifetime.
In summary, our research is concerned with

designing a sensor network for early forest fire detection, and our contributions are threefold: 1) we present a novel analysis of the FWIS, which could be of interest to sensor network researchers and to sensor manufacturers; 2) we model the forest detection problem as a wireless coverage problem, and propose a distributed algorithm to achieve full coverage of the forest; and 3) we present a simple but effective data aggregation scheme to prolong the network lifetime
